item: Row 191: the launcher writer wait no longer reads a writer caught mid-exec as ended
summary: A process read between exec and its loader setting its pages has an empty environment, so the writer token was invisible and the look failed a row on its way as LOST at 0.0 s (measured: 419 of 2000 spawns under load, 201 of 500 unloaded). Young own-user processes with no readable environment now count as starting for 5 s; red-before test makes the window 0.5 s for one writer.
